figures.caption: Figure 1: PhyMind. Blue: learned modules; orange: fixed physics. The encoder is a standard masked transformer. The decoder infers, for each of 68 cortical regions and each 1 s patch, oscillator and aperiodic parameters and waveforms, which a fixed BEM lead field, evaluated for the recording’s own derivations, projects to the sensors. Only a small, penalised sensor residual r bypasses the physics.

Figure 2: Left, middle: four-task mean balanced accuracy with frozen features and after full finetuning (hatched: + physics source features). Dashed line: released MANAS-2. Right: spectralprobe mean R2 with amplitude-normalised targets for models without any band-power target on encoder tokens.

Table 1: Frozen linear probing (LP-Avg): balanced accuracy (%), mean ± sd over three subjectdisjoint splits. “+ src” (pre-declared feature set) concatenates pooled encoder tokens with the physics decoder’s 68-region source features (PhyMind only). Params include the decoder for PhyMind (needed for + src); encoder-only counts are 4.9M (lite), 50.8M (large) and 92.8M (MANAS-2). † continued pre-training of the released MANAS-2 encoder. ∗ not stated in the MANAS-2 model card.

Table 2: Full fine-tuning (encoder and linear head trained end to end): balanced accuracy (%), mean ± sd over the same three subject-disjoint splits as Table 1; the epoch with the best validation balanced accuracy is evaluated. The first block is the controlled comparison (same encoder, data, steps and seed). Bold: best per task.

Table 3: Frozen token-level spectral probe (ridge regression, held-out subjects, R2, mean of three splits). Targets are computed from the per-channel z-scored window, so absolute channel amplitude, which MANAS-2’s normalised input cannot contain, is removed from every target (definitions in Sec. 4). ‡ Pre-trained with an auxiliary linear head predicting log band power from encoder tokens, i.e. directly supervised on six of the nine targets; these rows are not a fair comparison and are excluded from bolding. Bold: best among the remaining models.

Figure 3: Right- minus left-fist motor imagery, PhysioNet MI (paired t over subjects). Left: classical depth-weighted minimum-norm estimate (wMNE) with the same lead field. Middle: PhyMind-lite source power. Right: hemispheric contrast for sensorimotor regions. wMNE shows the expected contralateral pattern; PhyMind’s sources do not.
